topic: What if you could rewind 10 seconds?
title: WHAT IF YOU COULD
REWIND 10 SECONDS?

script.beat: 1 cold open: three quick demos of the power
script.text: You knock your coffee off the desk. Rewind. You catch it. You miss a step on the stairs. Rewind. You step right over the cat. Wrong answer in class? Rewind. Now you're a genius.
What if you could rewind ten seconds, any time you want?
It's about to ruin your life.

shots.note: Pip at his desk, the mug by his hand
the mug slides and tips over the edge
smash, white flash; REWIND plays this and the last shot backwards
the big step over the cat
wrong answer, the class laughs; REWIND
the turn: the sun cracks, the lights go out
